biography.value: A Flame Titan's Conflagration Aura reshapes the battlefield simply by existing — any environment with flammable material becomes a fire hazard within 15 feet of it, and enemies without fire resistance face meaningful damage just for closing to melee range. Fire Immunity Sharing protects the summoner and two allies from the collateral environmental damage the Flame Titan inevitably generates. Inferno Hurl's 15-foot diameter means it can suppress entire squads at range while closing to melee. A summoner who designates protected allies immediately on summoning and then stays clear will find the Flame Titan manages its own engagement effectively.

system.attacksNotes:
World-Breaker Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage; Burning condition + target knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage + Burning + Prone; all creatures within 10 feet of target take 8 fire damage from the impact shockwave.

Inferno Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft, 15-foot diameter

  • Margin 1:: 18 fire damage (15 + 3 Dex) + Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 18 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning.
  • Margin 3: 18 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Conflagration Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 15 feet take 9 fire damage (Half DR). Flammable objects within 15 feet ignite at the start of each round. Fire Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 2 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical fire damage while within 30 feet. Smoldering Wounds: When the Flame Titan deals Ignited or Burning condition to a target, that target cannot remove the condition through normal means for 1 round. Magical healing still removes it. Powerful Build: The Flame Titan counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Intimidating Presence: As a [Combat] action all creatures within 30 feet that can see and hear it make a Will save (opposed by Cha 4 + Intimidate 5). On failure: target gains the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Creatures immune to fear are unaffected. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Flame Titan fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
